<title level="1" right="Siege Weapon 1">[Teekdoon](/SiegeWeapons.aspx?ID=32)</title>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 117

<row gap="medium">
**Price** 50 gp

**Ammunition** boulder (0 gp, 5 Bulk)
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**Usage** portable, held in 8 hands

**Bulk** 15

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Crew** 4-6

**Proficiency** simple
</row>

</column>

---

While the official name of this contraption is the “portable catapult,” it gained the name “teekdoon” as a reference to the weapon’s initial inspiration: the diving takedowns of peregrine falcons. However, it replaces elegant dives with the brute force of falling weights that hit targets from above.

**Aim** <actions string="Two Actions" /> 25 feet, minimum distance 25 feet 

**Load** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) 2 times, requires a successful DC 12 [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) check 

**Launch** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=540), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [range increment 80 feet](/Rules.aspx?ID=2195)) 2d8 bludgeoning, single target, DC 14 Reflex. A boulder launched from a teekdoon descends on a creature from above, which might affect if a creature has [cover](/Rules.aspx?ID=2372) against the attack.
